'''Tassler trees''' were tall trees that grew in the [[Gungan Swamp|swamps]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]]. The tree produced small offshoots called tassler knees, which resembled humanoid knees. The tree's leaves were harvested by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] to make dyes.
